# Sunlogic SA

> Solar and certified electrical contracting for homes and businesses in Cape Town, South Africa. One team designs, installs and certifies each system — solar, electrical work, or the smart HotBot/SolarBot energy controllers — with council registration and Certificate of Compliance handled as part of the job, not an extra.

Sunlogic SA (Pty) Ltd, registration 2022/651654/07. Based at 9 Chesham Road, Claremont, Cape Town, 7708. Phone +27 (82) 655 5371, email sales@sunlogic.co.za.

sunlogic.co.za is the company page. The work itself lives on two division sites, each with its own services and blog.

## Divisions

- [Sunlogic Energy](https://energy.sunlogic.co.za): Solar sized to actual usage, batteries, backup power, and the HotBot/SolarBot smart controllers (Plentify hardware) for geyser and solar/battery systems. For homes, small businesses and larger sites.
- [Sunlogic Electrical](https://electrical.sunlogic.co.za): Certified electrical work — rewiring, compliance certificates, surge protection, EV chargers, maintenance, and council registration.

## On this site

- [Contact](https://sunlogic.co.za/contact.html): Free site assessment booking, office details, and the people who do the work.
- [Legal & Policies](https://sunlogic.co.za/legal.html): Terms, privacy policy, warranty statement, company details.
- [Sitemap](https://sunlogic.co.za/sitemap.xml)

The blog moved to the division sites. Each post is listed in that site's own llms.txt.
